title: Switch the editor to a dark theme
description: Use when changing an editor's theme through its Preferences dialog and handling the restart prompt.
overview: A GUI-only sequence: open Preferences, pick Dark, confirm, and defer the restart.

source.title: Switch the editor to a dark theme

steps.success_criteria: The Preferences dialog shows Theme, Font size and Autosave.

evidence.quote: Open Preferences from the Edit menu

steps.actions: Set the Theme field to Dark.

steps.success_criteria: The dialog closes and the status bar reads Theme: Dark.

steps.actions: In the Restart required prompt, click Later.
steps.success_criteria: The status bar notes the pending restart.

evidence.quote: Choose Later; the theme applies on the next launch
